item.title: Hello World
item.description:
This is my first post on my new Hugo website! Testing this out before fully migrating from WordPress :)

The switch isn’t straightforward. I spent some time wrestling with migration tools, but nothing clicked quite right. So here we are — building slowly, learning as I go, and as i failed to import stuff automagically, I’m planning to do it manually if and when the time feels right.

Why ditching wordpress after more than a decade?
